steps.text: Pause and take a moment to calmly assess what is happening.
steps.quote: Take a moment to calmly assess your situation

steps.text: Use your map, compass, GPS, or visible landmarks to work out where you are.
steps.quote: Use your map, compass, handheld GPS, or visible landmarks to try to find your location

steps.text: If it is safe, retrace your steps toward the route you planned.
steps.quote: If it is safe to do so, retrace your steps to get back on your planned route

steps.text: If you cannot retrace your steps, stay where you are.
Blow your whistle often so people can find you without you yelling.
steps.quote: Blowing a whistle helps people find you and saves your energy from yelling.

steps.text: Flash an SOS with your flashlight: three quick flashes, three slow, then three quick.
steps.quote: Flash the SOS pattern: Three times quickly, three times slowly, three times quickly.

steps.text: Flash your mirror to alert planes or helicopters nearby.
steps.quote: This can alert planes and helicopters flying in the area

steps.text: Lay bright clothing in a forest clearing where searchers can see it.
steps.quote: Lay out brightly-colored clothing in a forest clearing.

steps.text: Stay calm and think through what is happening.
steps.quote: Stay calm and think through the situation.

steps.text: Use your map, compass, GPS, or visible landmarks to work out where you are.
steps.quote: Use your map, compass, handheld GPS, or visible landmarks to try to find your location

steps.text: If it is safe, retrace your steps toward the route you planned.
steps.quote: If it is safe to do so, retrace your steps to get back on your planned route

steps.text: If you need to wait for help, conserve energy and wait patiently.
steps.quote: Wait patiently for help to arrive and conserve your energy
